single_method_paragraph: Trace-localised, independently-corroborated scarps: polarity-weighted one-sided LiDAR step, ridge-thinned by orientation non-maximum suppression on its own structure tensor (soft factor 0.25 off-ridge), corroborated within 200 m (max-filter radius 2 px) by the stronger of a U/K radiometric gradient ridge and the isostatic-gravity slope ridge (factor 0.35+0.65*w), softly piedmont-weighted (factor 0.45+0.55*pied_soft). No catalogue/SGMC training, no distance-to-catalogue feature, no scored-raster input.

new_components.ridge_soft_nms: structure tensor of gaussian(scarp_n, sigma=1.5), tensor smoothing sigma=2.0; 8-direction quantised NMS along dominant gradient direction; ridge = scarp_n where local max else 0.25*scarp_n
new_components.witness: w = max(norm(|grad UK|) , norm(iso_grav_anom_slope)) then maximum_filter size=5 (radius 2 px = 200 m); factor = 0.35+0.65*w. UK = geodawn_extensions_u8 band 2; zeros inside footprint treated as missing -> that witness term 0 there (gravity term still applies; factor floor 0.35 never zeroes a trace)

promotion_gate: selected arm beats h33_analogue_foldfair pooled HOLDOUT-DTI with paired 95% CI excluding 0 AND all leakage canaries symmetric AUC <= 0.90 AND uniqueness Spearman <= 0.90 and mutual 3px overlap <= 0.70 vs every accessible registry raster (surface + dots); else verdict=negative, DO-NOT-SUBMIT
secondary_proxy_report_only_not_for_sele: DTI vs SGMC off-catalogue piedmont subset (same definition as session-1)
